senses.gloss: ch. = h.מָשַׁל IIto speak mataphorically, recite a mashal.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 12:23">Targ. Ez. XII, 23</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Pesachim 114a:3">Pes. 114ᵃ</cite> <he>מתלא מַתְלִין וכ׳</he> they have a saying (witticism) about it in the West.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 1:1:12">Y. Dem. I, 21ᵈ</cite> top; a. e.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 14:9">Targ. Prov. XIV, 9</cite> (h. text <he>יָלִיץ</he>).

senses.gloss: to place beside, to compare. Y. Dem. l. c. (play on שׁוּמִּירָה) שמר מרה מאן מ׳ ליך וכ׳ guarding bitterness—who classed thee among the spices? Ib. (play on כּוּסְבַּר) מאן מַתְלִיךְ וכ׳, v. כּוּסְבַּרְתָּא.—Part. pass. מְתִיל; f. מְתִילָא; pl. מְתִילִין, מְתִילֵי; מְתִילָן compared, comparable.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ecclesiastes 12:2">Targ. Koh. XII, 2</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Chullin 59b:9">Ḥull. 59ᵇ</cite> <he>כאריא מ׳</he> is compared to a lion.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 83b:5">B. Mets. 83ᵇ</cite> <he>לאו כחיותא מ׳</he> are they (robbers) not like wild beasts?—
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 21:5">Targ. Ez. XXI, 5</cite>.

senses.gloss: to propound a riddle. Targ. II Esth. I, 3.

units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 28:1">Targ. Ps. XXVIII, 1</cite>.
